scope: offline research assurance only; not mission completion

assumptions.statement: Defined GHC Double values use IEEE binary64, without unsafe capability forgery; excludes bottom and compiler/hardware bugs.
Trusted callers provide truthful evidence; no research proposal is imported into an order-authorizing path.
Z3, the checker, compiler, runtimes and hardware belong to the trusted computing base; no independently checked proof certificate.
Two callers and atomic abstract steps; completion fairness for draining; no production refinement.
Integer indexing is exact; historical publication and first-seen timing are not independently witnessed.
Exact real algebra does not establish binary64 accounting, market fills or calibrated costs.

entries.claim: The two-caller abstract protocol never gains authority, forbids new calls while draining and decreases outstanding calls on every completion.
entries.formalStatement: The two-caller abstract protocol never gains authority, forbids new calls while draining and decreases outstanding calls on every completion.
entries.result: All reachable-state and transition invariants pass; stop drains within two completion events under stated fairness.
entries.bounds: Two callers, 75 reachable states, 349 directed transitions; reachable fixed point, maximum shortest path 6.
entries.limitations: Abstract client protocol only. No implemented production lifecycle, locks, persisted ownership, bounded timeout or server refinement. Liveness requires completion fairness.

entries.claim: Compiled Haskell agrees with the independent executable contract on all enumerated and seeded binary64 fixtures.
entries.formalStatement: Compiled Haskell agrees with the independent executable contract on all enumerated and seeded binary64 fixtures.
entries.result: All 20,480 fixtures and default mode match; 240 accepted fixtures preserve bits and deny authority.
entries.bounds: 16,384 exhaustive representative cases; 4,096 generated bit-pattern cases; seed 20260920.
entries.limitations: Only the explicitly enumerated representative domain is exhaustive. Generated cases and cross-language tests are not a universal proof.

entries.claim: Proof rosters, source hashes, required fields, assumptions, counterexamples and bidirectional paths fail closed on mismatch.
entries.formalStatement: Proof rosters, source hashes, required fields, assumptions, counterexamples and bidirectional paths fail closed on mismatch.
entries.result: Malformed ledger and safety mutations are rejected by regression tests.
entries.bounds: Declared schema, source hashes and deterministic negative fixtures.
entries.limitations: Trusted checker code and reviewed Git changes; not tamper-proof against a maintainer editing the verifier and receipts together.

entries.claim: Universal source/compiler refinement and production lifecycle, accounting and data-availability proofs remain open.
entries.formalStatement: Universal source/compiler refinement and production lifecycle, accounting and data-availability proofs remain open.
entries.limitations: No promotion allowed. Existing empirical rejection and protected data constraints also remain binding.
